items.title: Characterization of w-contractible affine schemes as weakly contractible objects of the big pro-etale site
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file proetale.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: The lemma proves the equivalence of w-contractibility of an affine ring A, weak contractibility of the corresponding object of the big pro-etale site and the refinement property for pro-etale coverings by finite Zariski coverings (statement lines 3026-3040). The proof (proof lines 3042-3084) quotes the known equivalence of the first and third conditions, deduces weak contractibility by refining coverings and using products over finite Zariski covers, and deduces w-contractibility by producing a retraction from a faithfully flat weakly etale extension. H2: two implications with four inputs, written out in full.
